description: Wave 4a: editor/console/lock on 2 windowed F2F 0.32 clients (alice = owner, bob = admin) + real olife-sandboxd. A opens the bench editor with the Injector (hotbar key 1, aim, RMB via F2F input), clears, types code (F2F chars + Enter) and clicks Run (mouse on the XML button rect): world status RUN with the typed code hash, the bench moves on the server and on B; ConsoleDelta only at A (subscribed); B opens read-only (RequestReply 4, Save -> 5); A Esc -> lock free -> B Edit, Save (0), Close. Then A again: template from the select (button mode), file save/load (config:olife/scripts), a syntax error -> ERROR (console line, B's tag), Stop, Close. Then negative requests of carol (not owner/admin) and a console flood (bounded deltas), consistency 0.
